# vktModifiersTests

## Overview

`vktModifiersTests.cpp` is the registered implementation file for the Vulkan CTS `drm_format_modifiers` category. The category root is registered from the Vulkan test package as `drm_format_modifiers`, which delegates to `modifiers::createTests` ([vktTestPackage.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/vktTestPackage.cpp#L1385-L1387)). The implementation constructs the root test-case group from the `name` passed by the package and adds twelve direct child groups for querying, creating, binding, exporting, and importing images that use `VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1601-L1766)).

The source directory is named `modules/vulkan/modifiers/`, while the registered public test category is `drm_format_modifiers` ([vktTestPackage.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/vktTestPackage.cpp#L1385-L1387), [vktModifiersTests.hpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.hpp#L29-L35)).

## Role of File

| Aspect | Evidence-backed description |
|---|---|
| Registration role | `createTests()` creates the root `TestCaseGroup` using the supplied `name` and registers all direct children in this file ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1601-L1766)). |
| Implementation role | The same file implements support checks, modifier enumeration, image creation helpers, export/import paths, suballocation paths, and pixel-result comparisons ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L71-L179), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L341-L457), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L590-L1597)). |
| Related generated data | Direct format cases are generated by iterating `formats::basicColorFormats` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1610-L1621), [vkFormatLists.inl](../../../framework/vulkan/generated/vulkan/vkFormatLists.inl#L1191-L1324)). |
| Mustpass evidence | The default mustpass list contains the registered `drm_format_modifiers.*` paths, including all twelve direct child groups and 131 format leaves per group ([drm-format-modifiers.txt](../../../mustpass/main/vk-default/drm-format-modifiers.txt#L1180-L1310)). |

## Test Families

### list_modifiers — Enumerate DRM format modifiers

`list_modifiers` is populated for every format in `formats::basicColorFormats` and uses `VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesListEXT` with `VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_PROPERTIES_LIST_EXT` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1604-L1626)). Each case queries the format's DRM modifier list, rejects empty modifier lists as unsupported, checks compatible modifiers for 2D color-attachment/sampled images using opaque-FD external-memory requirements, verifies nonzero modifier tiling features, and checks minimum image extent and array-layer properties ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L341-L382)).

### list_modifiers_fmt_features2 — Enumerate modifiers through the format-feature-flags2 path

`list_modifiers_fmt_features2` mirrors `list_modifiers`, but it uses `VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesList2EXT`, `VkDrmFormatModifierProperties2EXT`, and `VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_PROPERTIES_LIST_2_EXT` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1604-L1626)). Its support check adds a requirement for `VK_KHR_format_feature_flags2` after the base modifier requirements ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L91-L97)).

### list_modifiers_consistency — Compare legacy and flags2 modifier lists

`list_modifiers_consistency` registers one case per basic color format and compares the modifier list returned through `VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesListEXT` with the list returned through `VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesList2EXT` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1628-L1637)). The implementation allows the flags2 list to contain at least as many entries, indexes both lists by modifier value, and fails if a legacy-list modifier is missing, if plane counts differ, or if the overlapping feature bits are inconsistent ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L385-L457)).

### create_list_modifiers — Create images from modifier lists

`create_list_modifiers` builds a modifier-list image-creation test for each basic color format using the legacy modifier-properties list path ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1639-L1661)). For compatible modifiers, it creates 64x64 2D images with `VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT` and increasing prefixes of the compatible modifier list, then verifies the created image reports a DRM modifier that was present in the submitted list ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L590-L645)).

### create_list_modifiers_fmt_features2 — Create images from flags2 modifier lists

`create_list_modifiers_fmt_features2` uses the same image-list creation logic as `create_list_modifiers`, but its cases are registered with the flags2 modifier-list template instantiation and support check ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1639-L1661)).

### bound_to_dma_buf — Bind DRM-modifier images to dma-buf exportable memory

`bound_to_dma_buf` registers one legacy-list case per basic color format ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1663-L1677)). Each case filters modifiers for 2D images with transfer-src and transfer-dst usage, `VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_DMA_BUF_BIT_EXT`, and exportable external-memory support, creates 64x64 images with increasing modifier-list prefixes, binds exportable memory, and obtains a native dma-buf handle ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L648-L711)).

### create_explicit_modifier — Recreate images with explicit modifier plane layouts

`create_explicit_modifier` registers a legacy-list explicit-modifier image-creation case for each basic color format ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1679-L1703)). For each compatible modifier, the test first creates a reference image from a one-element modifier list, queries per-plane layouts with `vkGetImageSubresourceLayout`, zeroes `size`, `arrayPitch`, and `depthPitch` fields as required by cited spec comments in the source, then creates an image through `VkImageDrmFormatModifierExplicitCreateInfoEXT` and checks that the reported modifier equals the requested modifier ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L714-L805)).

### create_explicit_modifier_fmt_features2 — Explicit modifier creation through flags2 modifier lists

`create_explicit_modifier_fmt_features2` uses the same explicit-modifier verification path as `create_explicit_modifier`, but registers the flags2 list/template instantiation and requires `VK_KHR_format_feature_flags2` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1679-L1703), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L91-L97)).

### export_import — Export and import opaque-FD DRM-modifier images

`export_import` registers one legacy-list export/import case per basic color format ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1705-L1733)). The helper filters modifiers for transfer/blit format features and opaque-FD export/import support before running each compatible modifier ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L228-L263)). For each modifier, it fills a 64x64 reference image with component gradients, copies through a source image into an exportable DRM-modifier destination image, verifies the destination image reports the expected modifier, exports the memory FD, imports it into an explicitly described DRM-modifier image, copies back to a non-modifier image, and compares the readback with zero integer threshold ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L822-L1088)).

### export_import_fmt_features2 — Export/import through flags2 modifier lists

`export_import_fmt_features2` registers the same opaque-FD export/import workflow as `export_import`, but with `VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesList2EXT`/`VkDrmFormatModifierProperties2EXT` and the flags2 support path ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1705-L1733), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L91-L97)).

### export_import_with_suballoc — Export/import with two DRM-modifier images in one allocation

`export_import_with_suballoc` registers one legacy-list case per basic color format and uses the suballocation helper ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1735-L1764)). The helper first requires the selected opaque-FD modifier path to support export/import without `VK_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_FEATURE_DEDICATED_ONLY_BIT`, creates two DRM-modifier destination images, rejects cases whose memory requirements indicate dedicated allocation, binds both images into a single exportable allocation at aligned offsets, exports the FD, imports it into two explicit-modifier images, and copies each imported image to an output image ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1109-L1520)). It then issues two comparison calls named for the prime and suballocated images; in the inspected source, both comparison accessors are constructed from `outputBuffer`, not from both output buffers ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1522-L1541)). If every compatible modifier is rejected as unsupported for suballocation, the wrapper reports `NotSupportedError`; if any supported modifier produces an unexpected comparison result, it fails ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1544-L1597)).

### export_import_fmt_features2_with_suballoc — Suballocation export/import through flags2 lists

`export_import_fmt_features2_with_suballoc` registers the same suballocation workflow as `export_import_with_suballoc`, but through the flags2 modifier-list template instantiation and support check ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1735-L1764), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L91-L97)).

## Parameter Dimensions and Observed Values

| Dimension | Observed values or source |
|---|---|
| Direct child groups | 12 groups registered directly under `drm_format_modifiers` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1604-L1764)). |
| Format set | `formats::basicColorFormats`; the generated Vulkan list contains 131 formats from `VK_FORMAT_R4G4_UNORM_PACK8` through `VK_FORMAT_A4B4G4R4_UNORM_PACK16` ([vkFormatLists.inl](../../../framework/vulkan/generated/vulkan/vkFormatLists.inl#L1191-L1324)). Mustpass contains 131 format leaves per direct child in the default list ([drm-format-modifiers.txt](../../../mustpass/main/vk-default/drm-format-modifiers.txt#L1180-L1310)). |
| Modifier-list API variants | Legacy `VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesListEXT` and flags2 `VkDrmFormatModifierPropertiesList2EXT` variants are used through template parameters in the registered cases ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1613-L1620), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1687-L1698)). |
| Image shape | Modifier image creation helpers use 2D, 64x64, one mip level, one array layer, and `VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L516-L532), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L569-L585)). |
| Image usages | Listing and explicit/list creation paths use color-attachment plus sampled usage; dma-buf binding and export/import data paths use transfer-src plus transfer-dst usage where images are copied ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L356-L360), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L656-L670), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L892-L895)). |
| External-memory handle types | Opaque-FD is used for most export/import and compatibility filters; dma-buf is used by `bound_to_dma_buf` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L250-L255), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L668-L670)). |
| Modifier iteration | Runtime modifier values come from `vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties2` with a modifier-list structure in `pNext`; the helper makes a count query and then a data query ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L104-L127)). |

## Support and Feature Requirements

The base support check requires `VK_EXT_image_drm_format_modifier`, instance support for `VK_KHR_get_physical_device_properties2`, `VK_KHR_bind_memory2`, and `VK_KHR_image_format_list` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L71-L89)). In non-Vulkan SC builds, the two maintenance5-introduced formats visible in the inspected code, `VK_FORMAT_A8_UNORM_KHR` and `VK_FORMAT_A1B5G5R5_UNORM_PACK16_KHR`, additionally require `VK_KHR_maintenance5` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L85-L88)).

The flags2 variants additionally require `VK_KHR_format_feature_flags2` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L91-L97)). Export/import tests additionally require `VK_KHR_external_memory_fd` before running the modifier compatibility filter ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L265-L281)). Individual cases may report unsupported when no DRM modifiers exist for the format, when no modifier is compatible with the requested image features and external-memory handle type, or when suballocation requires dedicated allocation ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L350-L380), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L619-L621), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1191-L1201)).

## Verification Methods

| Family | Verification observed in source |
|---|---|
| Listing | Checks that compatible modifiers expose nonzero tiling features and usable image format properties, then logs modifier and image-property details ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L353-L375)). |
| Consistency | Compares legacy and flags2 modifier data by modifier key, checking presence, plane count, and common feature bits ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L398-L455)). |
| Modifier-list image creation | Verifies the image's reported DRM modifier is one of the modifiers passed to the create-info list ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L623-L642)). |
| dma-buf binding | Verifies image creation, exportable memory allocation, image binding, and native-handle export complete without Vulkan or helper errors ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L681-L708)). |
| Explicit modifier creation | Verifies the image created with explicit plane layouts reports the requested modifier ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L756-L803)). |
| Export/import | Verifies the exported image reports the selected modifier, then compares copied readback against the reference image with zero integer threshold ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L970-L1088)). |
| Export/import with suballocation | Verifies non-dedicated allocation suitability, binds two images into one allocation, imports two explicit images from one FD-backed allocation, copies both imported images to output images, and issues two comparison calls; in the inspected source, both comparison accessors are constructed from `outputBuffer` ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1191-L1226), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1516-L1541)). |

## Test Principles

- Query modifier lists from the implementation rather than hard-coding modifier values, because the concrete DRM modifiers are platform dependent ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L104-L127)).
- Use the same `formats::basicColorFormats` iteration across all direct groups so each family is generated for the same observed color-format set ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1610-L1760), [vkFormatLists.inl](../../../framework/vulkan/generated/vulkan/vkFormatLists.inl#L1191-L1324)).
- Validate both metadata-level behavior, such as list consistency and reported modifier values, and data-path behavior, such as copy/export/import round-trips with exact integer readback comparison in the non-suballocation export/import helper ([vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L385-L457), [vktModifiersTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/vktModifiersTests.cpp#L1074-L1088)).

## Notes and Uncertainties

- The requested category name `drm_format_modifiers` does not correspond to a source directory with that exact name in the inspected tree. The registered category is created from `modules/vulkan/modifiers/` through `modifiers::createTests` ([vktTestPackage.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/vktTestPackage.cpp#L1385-L1387), [CMakeLists.txt](../../../modules/vulkan/modifiers/CMakeLists.txt#L8-L20)).
